sentences.text:
, on 1 October, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.21587 of 2024
Order:

This writ petition has been filed seeking to declare the action of respondent Nos.1 to 4 in not taking any action to initiate proceedings and not paying compensation under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act"), in respect of the lands in Survey No.173/A admeasuring 500.33 square yards belonging to petitioner No.1, land admeasuring 32.33 square yards belonging to petitioner No.2 situated at Enumamula village, Warangal Mandal, Hanamkonda District, acquired for the purpose of inner ring/bypass road as illegal, arbitrary and for other appropriate reliefs.
2. The petitioners claim to be the owners and possessors of land in Survey No.173/A admeasuring Ac.1.00 situated at Enumamula village, Warangal Mandal, Hanamkonda District, having purchased the same from one Mr. Puli Venkataiah, who was the original pattadar and possessor of the land in Survey No.173/A admeasuring Acs.3.00 situated at Enumamula Village, Warangal Mandal.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioners that out of the said total land, the original owner sold the subject land in their favour, after grant of exemption by the competent authority under the Urban Land Ceiling Act.

It is the further case of the petitioners that initially the Government proposed to acquire lands in various survey numbers including the land in Survey No.173/A situated at Enumamula Village, for the purpose of providing house sites to weaker sections, and accordingly notification under Section 4(1)
of the Land Acquisition Act has also been issued on 04.11.1985, however the said proceedings were not finalised and as such they stood lapsed.

It is the further case of the petitioners that subsequently,
respondent No.2 issued a notification dated 01.08.2019 under the provisions of the Act proposing to acquire an extent of Ac.83.17 guntas of land situated at Urus, Thimmapur, Khilla Warangal and Enumamula Villages for the purpose of laying inner ring/bypass road, but without including the land of the petitioners in Survey No.173/A in the said notification, even though the said land is going to be affected under the proposed inner ring/bypass road.

3. The grievance of the petitioners is that even though they submitted representations dated 24.08.202 and 13.02.2023, duly enclosing all the relevant documents on the file of the respondents,
requesting to initiate land acquisition proceedings in respect of their land and for payment of compensation under the provisions of the Act, the respondents have not taken any action thereon so far.

4. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent No.1 has placed on record the written instructions issued by the Revenue Divisional Officer, Warangal, wherein it is stated that the Vice-Chairman, KUDA Warangal, has filed a requisition in Form-B for acquisition of land for formation of 200 feet master plan by-pass (Inner Ring Road) from Khammam Road to Mulugu Road connecting Narsampet Road to an extent of Ac.9.5 guntas of land of Enumamula Village of Warangal Mandal; as per the instructions of the Collector, Warangal, preliminary Katakam Omkar vs The State Of Telangana, on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128789314/
1 notification has been submitted under Section 11(1) of the Act for an extent of Ac.9.25 guntas of land of Enumamula Village; on approval of the collector, Warangal, preliminary notification has been published on 24.06.2023 for acquisition of lands for an extent of Ac.9.25 guntas for formation of 200 feet Master-Plan By-pass (Inner Ring Road) from Khammam Raod to Mulugu Road connecting Narsampet Road situated at Enumamula Village; no claims and objections have been received against the said notification; declaration has been issued and published on 19.06.2024 including the subject land to an extent of Ac.0.30 guntas in Survey No.173; and after following due process of law, award enquiry notices were also issued to be held on 20.08.2024 under Section 21(1) of the Act for all the interested persons in such land.
5.

entities.text: Katakam Omkar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Since it appears that the award enquiry notices under Section 21(1) of the Act were already issued calling for objections from all the interested persons, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition by directing the respondents to consider the representations dated 24.08.2022 and 13.02.2023 submitted by the petitioners by treating the same as objections filed under Section 21(1)
of the Act and pass appropriate orders thereon as per the provisions of the Act.
However, if it is found that there is any dispute, the same shall be referred under Section 64 of the Act for adjudication by the Authority.
6. The writ petition is accordingly disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.

C.V.BHASKAR REDDY, J 01.10.2024 JSU Katakam Omkar vs The State Of Telangana, on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128789314/
